The report page, behind IAP: Google sign-in, no proxy. It shows the run that just finished, with the agent's briefing.
Each source's monthly total comes from a SQL tool in MCP Toolbox.
Ask it a question. The agent calls count_findings with the filters the question needs; SQL counts and sums.
5 zombiescan findings at $10 a month or more, $111.94 in total. A direct SQL query on the same run returns the same numbers.
Most expensive first: a snapshot of a deleted disk, stopped VMs whose disks still bill, a static IP attached to nothing.
The static IP w1 is the one resource both sources flagged, each at $7.30 a month.
Everything else came from zombiescan alone: snapshots, stopped instances, stale repositories and secrets.
Every sweep adds a row, so a resource cleaned up drops out the next day.
